cards.definition: Data as vertices and edges, suited to highly connected data; queried with Cypher, SPARQL or Datalog.
cards.example: Social networks: people follow people.

zh-Hans.definition: 以顶点和边表示数据，适合高度关联的数据；用 Cypher、SPARQL 或 Datalog 查询。

cards.definition: Graph where vertices and edges carry key-value properties and edge labels.
cards.example: (:Person {name})-[:LIVES_IN]->(:City).

zh-Hans.definition: 顶点和边都带有键值属性和边标签的图。

cards.definition: Stores facts as (subject, predicate, object) triples.
cards.example: (Lucy, livesIn, Idaho).

zh-Hans.definition: 以（主语、谓语、宾语）三元组存储事实。

cards.definition: In-memory map from key to byte offset in an append-only log file.
cards.example: Bitcask keeps all keys in RAM.

zh-Hans.definition: 从键到追加日志文件中字节偏移的内存映射。

cards.definition: Sorted string table: immutable segment file with keys in sorted order, enabling merges and sparse indexes.
cards.example: Memtable flushed to disk as an SSTable.

zh-Hans.definition: 键有序的不可变段文件，便于合并和稀疏索引。

cards.definition: Log-structured merge tree: writes go to an in-memory memtable, flushed to SSTables and compacted in the background.
cards.example: LevelDB, RocksDB, Cassandra.

zh-Hans.definition: 日志结构合并树：写入内存表，刷写为 SSTable 并在后台压缩合并。

cards.definition: Merging segment files and discarding overwritten or deleted keys.
cards.example: Size-tiered vs leveled compaction.

zh-Hans.definition: 合并段文件并丢弃已覆盖或删除的键。

cards.definition: Probabilistic set that can say “definitely not present”, saving disk reads for missing keys.
cards.example: LSM lookup skips SSTables the filter rules out.

zh-Hans.definition: 可判定“一定不存在”的概率集合，为缺失键省去磁盘读取。

cards.definition: Balanced tree of fixed-size pages updated in place; the standard index in relational databases.
cards.example: A 4-level B-tree with 4 KB pages holds 256 TB.

zh-Hans.definition: 由固定大小页面组成、原地更新的平衡树；关系数据库的标准索引。

cards.definition: Append-only log of changes written before modifying pages, for crash recovery.
cards.example: Postgres replays the WAL after a crash.

zh-Hans.definition: 在修改页面前写入的追加日志，用于崩溃恢复。

cards.definition: One logical write causing many physical writes over the data’s lifetime.
cards.example: Compaction rewrites data several times.

zh-Hans.definition: 一次逻辑写入在数据生命周期内导致多次物理写入。

cards.definition: Index on a non-primary-key column for faster lookups by that value.
cards.example: Index users by email.

zh-Hans.definition: 在非主键列上建立的索引，加快按该值查找。

cards.definition: Changing data formats while staying backward and forward compatible.
cards.example: Add an optional field without breaking old readers.

zh-Hans.definition: 在保持向后和向前兼容的同时修改数据格式。

cards.definition: Backward: new code reads old data; forward: old code reads new data.
cards.example: Rolling upgrades need both.

zh-Hans.definition: 向后：新代码读旧数据；向前：旧代码读新数据。

cards.definition: Binary encodings with a schema and numbered field tags.
cards.example: Field tag 3 stays meaningful across versions.

zh-Hans.definition: 带模式和字段编号标签的二进制编码。

cards.definition: Binary encoding with no field tags; reader and writer schemas are resolved at read time.
cards.example: Hadoop pipelines store the writer schema in the file.

zh-Hans.definition: 无字段标签的二进制编码；读取时解析读者与写者模式。

cards.definition: Data moves via databases, service calls (REST/RPC) or asynchronous message passing.
cards.example: A message broker decouples sender and receiver.

zh-Hans.definition: 数据经由数据库、服务调用（REST/RPC）或异步消息传递流动。

cards.definition: One leader accepts writes and streams changes to followers that serve reads.
cards.example: MySQL primary with read replicas.

zh-Hans.definition: 由一个主节点接收写入并向提供读取的从节点传播变更。

cards.definition: Sync waits for a follower to confirm; async does not, risking loss on failover.
cards.example: Semi-synchronous: one sync follower, rest async.

zh-Hans.definition: 同步复制等待从节点确认；异步不等待，故障切换时可能丢数据。

cards.definition: Promoting a follower to leader when the leader fails.
cards.example: Split brain if two nodes both think they lead.

zh-Hans.definition: 主节点故障时将某个从节点提升为主节点。

cards.definition: Delay before a write on the leader appears on followers; causes stale reads.
cards.example: A user posts, refreshes, and the post is missing.

zh-Hans.definition: 主节点写入后到从节点可见之间的延迟；导致读到过期数据。

cards.definition: A user always sees their own updates.
cards.example: Read your own profile from the leader.

zh-Hans.definition: 用户总能看到自己的更新。

cards.definition: A user never sees data go back in time across successive reads.
cards.example: Pin each user to one replica.

zh-Hans.definition: 用户的连续读取不会看到数据“倒退”。

cards.definition: Several nodes accept writes and exchange changes; needs conflict resolution.
cards.example: One leader per datacenter.

zh-Hans.definition: 多个节点接受写入并交换变更；需要冲突解决。

cards.definition: Deciding the outcome of concurrent writes: last-write-wins, merging, or custom logic.
cards.example: Two users edit the same title offline.

zh-Hans.definition: 决定并发写入的结果：最后写入胜出、合并或自定义逻辑。

cards.definition: Clients write to and read from several replicas directly (Dynamo-style).
cards.example: Cassandra, Riak.

zh-Hans.definition: 客户端直接向多个副本读写（Dynamo 风格）。

cards.definition: With n replicas, writes to w and reads from r overlap when w + r > n.

zh-Hans.definition: n 个副本时，当 w + r > n，写入 w 个与读取 r 个必有重叠。

cards.definition: Fixing stale replicas when reads detect them, or via a background process.
cards.example: Reader writes the newer value back to the stale node.

zh-Hans.definition: 读取时发现过期副本即修复，或由后台进程修复。

cards.definition: Per-replica version numbers that detect concurrent (conflicting) writes.
cards.example: Siblings kept when neither version dominates.

zh-Hans.definition: 每副本的版本号，用于检测并发（冲突）写入。

cards.definition: Splitting data so each node holds a subset, spreading load and size.
cards.example: Users A–M on node 1, N–Z on node 2.

zh-Hans.definition: 拆分数据使每个节点只保存一部分，以分散负载和容量。

cards.definition: Each partition owns a contiguous key range; good for range scans, risks hot spots.
cards.example: Timestamps as keys put all writes on one partition.

zh-Hans.definition: 每个分区负责连续键范围；利于范围扫描但易出现热点。

cards.definition: Partition by hash of the key to spread load evenly; loses range queries.
cards.example: hash(user_id) mod 16.

zh-Hans.definition: 按键的哈希分区以均匀分散负载；失去范围查询能力。

cards.definition: A partition receiving disproportionate load.
cards.example: A celebrity’s user ID.

zh-Hans.definition: 某个分区承受不成比例的负载。

cards.definition: Local (document-partitioned): each partition indexes its own data, reads scatter; global (term-partitioned): index partitioned by term.
cards.example: Searching by color hits every partition with a local index.

zh-Hans.definition: 本地：各分区只索引自身数据，查询需分散；全局：按词条对索引分区。

cards.definition: Moving partitions between nodes as the cluster grows or shrinks.
cards.example: Fixed 1,000 partitions reassigned to new nodes.

zh-Hans.definition: 集群扩缩时在节点间迁移分区。

cards.definition: Finding which node holds a key: any node forwards, a routing tier, or partition-aware clients.
cards.example: ZooKeeper tracks partition assignment.

zh-Hans.definition: 确定键所在节点：任意节点转发、路由层或感知分区的客户端。

cards.definition: Hashing scheme where adding a node moves only a small share of keys.
cards.example: Keys map to points on a ring.

zh-Hans.definition: 增加节点时只需迁移少量键的哈希方案。

cards.definition: Some parts of a distributed system fail while others work, nondeterministically.
cards.example: One of five nodes stops responding.

zh-Hans.definition: 分布式系统中部分组件失效而其他正常，且不可预测。

cards.definition: Messages may be lost, delayed, duplicated or reordered; you cannot tell a slow node from a dead one.
cards.example: A request times out — did it run?

zh-Hans.definition: 消息可能丢失、延迟、重复或乱序；无法区分慢节点与故障节点。

cards.definition: Declaring a node dead after no response for a set time; too short causes false positives.
cards.example: Failover triggered by a GC pause.

zh-Hans.definition: 一段时间无响应即判定节点故障；过短会产生误判。

cards.definition: Network fault splitting nodes into groups that cannot talk to each other.
cards.example: Datacenter link cut.

zh-Hans.definition: 网络故障将节点分割成无法互相通信的组。

cards.definition: Machines’ clocks disagree and drift; NTP only partly corrects them.
cards.example: Last-write-wins drops a newer write with an older timestamp.

zh-Hans.definition: 各机器时钟不一致且会漂移；NTP 只能部分校正。

cards.definition: Monotonic clocks only move forward (for durations); time-of-day clocks can jump.
cards.example: Measure timeouts with a monotonic clock.

zh-Hans.definition: 单调时钟只向前走（用于测时长）；日历时钟可能跳变。

cards.definition: A node stops for seconds (GC, VM suspend) and then continues unaware.
cards.example: A lease expires during a GC pause.

zh-Hans.definition: 节点因 GC、虚拟机挂起等停顿数秒后继续运行而不自知。

cards.definition: Increasing number issued with each lock/lease so the storage rejects writes from a stale holder.
cards.example: Token 33 is rejected after token 34 was used.

zh-Hans.definition: 每次加锁/租约发放的递增编号，存储据此拒绝过期持有者的写入。

cards.definition: A node behaves arbitrarily or lies, not just crashes.
cards.example: A compromised node sends conflicting messages.

zh-Hans.definition: 节点任意行为或说谎，而不只是崩溃。

cards.definition: A node’s view is not truth; decisions are made by a majority of nodes.
cards.example: A node voted dead is dead even if it disagrees.

zh-Hans.definition: 单个节点的判断不等于事实；由多数节点做决定。

cards.definition: System behaves as if there is one copy of the data and operations are atomic at a single point in time.
cards.example: After a write completes, every read sees it.

zh-Hans.definition: 系统表现为数据只有一份副本，操作在某一时间点原子生效。

cards.definition: During a network partition, a system must choose between consistency (linearizability) and availability.
cards.example: A CP store refuses writes on the minority side.

zh-Hans.definition: 网络分区时，系统必须在一致性（线性一致）与可用性之间取舍。

cards.definition: Operations that are causally related are seen in the same order by everyone.
cards.example: A reply is never seen before the question.

zh-Hans.definition: 具有因果关系的操作在所有节点上以相同顺序被看到。

cards.definition: (counter, node ID) pairs giving a total order consistent with causality.
cards.example: Each node takes max(seen) + 1.

zh-Hans.definition: （计数器, 节点 ID）对，提供与因果一致的全序。

cards.definition: Every node delivers the same messages in the same order, reliably; equivalent to consensus.
cards.example: Replicated state machine log.

zh-Hans.definition: 所有节点可靠地以相同顺序投递相同消息；等价于共识。

cards.definition: Coordinator asks all participants to prepare, then commits only if all voted yes.
cards.example: Coordinator crash blocks participants in doubt.

zh-Hans.definition: 协调者先让所有参与者准备，全部同意后才提交。

cards.definition: A distributed transaction either commits on every node or aborts on all.
cards.example: Debit and credit in two databases.

zh-Hans.definition: 分布式事务要么在所有节点提交，要么全部中止。

cards.definition: Nodes agree on a value despite failures, satisfying agreement, integrity, validity and termination.
cards.example: Raft, Paxos, Zab.

zh-Hans.definition: 节点在故障下就某个值达成一致，满足一致性、完整性、有效性和终止性。

cards.definition: Consensus algorithms using epochs (terms) and majority quorums to elect leaders and order log entries.
cards.example: etcd uses Raft.

zh-Hans.definition: 利用纪元（任期）和多数法定人数选举主节点并排序日志的共识算法。

cards.definition: Small consensus-backed store for locks, leader election and membership.
cards.example: ZooKeeper, etcd.

zh-Hans.definition: 基于共识的小型存储，用于锁、选主和成员管理。

cards.definition: Small tools that do one thing, composed through a uniform interface (pipes of text).
cards.example: cat log | sort | uniq -c.

zh-Hans.definition: 只做一件事的小工具，通过统一接口（文本管道）组合。

cards.definition: Batch model: mappers emit key-value pairs, the framework sorts by key, reducers aggregate each key.
cards.example: Count page views per URL over HDFS logs.

zh-Hans.definition: 批处理模型：映射器输出键值对，框架按键排序，归约器按键汇总。

cards.definition: Distributed file system storing large files as replicated blocks across machines.
cards.example: Input and output of MapReduce jobs.

zh-Hans.definition: 将大文件以多副本块分布在多台机器上存储的分布式文件系统。

cards.definition: Both inputs are sorted by key so matching records meet in the same reducer.
cards.example: Join click events with user profiles.

zh-Hans.definition: 两个输入按键排序，使匹配记录在同一归约器中相遇。

cards.definition: Map-side join: a small dataset is loaded into every mapper’s memory.
cards.example: Join events with a small country table.

zh-Hans.definition: 映射端连接：将小数据集加载到每个映射器的内存中。

cards.definition: Runs a whole workflow as one job graph, avoiding materialising every intermediate step.
cards.example: Spark, Flink, Tez.

zh-Hans.definition: 将整个工作流作为一个作业图运行，避免物化每个中间步骤。

cards.definition: Graph processing in rounds where vertices exchange messages.
cards.example: PageRank iterations.

zh-Hans.definition: 顶点按轮次交换消息的图处理模型。

cards.definition: Unbounded, incrementally processed sequence of immutable events.
cards.example: Clicks flowing into Kafka.

zh-Hans.definition: 无界、增量处理的不可变事件序列。

cards.definition: Server that receives messages from producers and delivers them to consumers.
cards.example: RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ.

zh-Hans.definition: 接收生产者消息并投递给消费者的服务器。

cards.definition: Append-only partitioned log; consumers track offsets and can replay.
cards.example: Kafka topic with 12 partitions.

zh-Hans.definition: 追加式分区日志；消费者记录偏移量并可重放。

cards.definition: Position a consumer has read up to in a log partition.
cards.example: Restart from offset 51,200 after a crash.

zh-Hans.definition: 消费者在日志分区中已读到的位置。

cards.definition: Streaming every change from a database’s log to other systems.
cards.example: Debezium feeds a search index from MySQL binlog.

zh-Hans.definition: 将数据库日志中的每次变更流式传送给其他系统。

cards.definition: Store all changes as immutable events and derive current state from them.
cards.example: Cart state = replay of AddItem/RemoveItem events.

zh-Hans.definition: 以不可变事件存储所有变更，并由此推导当前状态。

cards.definition: Keeping only the latest value per key in a log, so it can rebuild state.
cards.example: Kafka compacted topic of user profiles.

zh-Hans.definition: 日志中每个键只保留最新值，使其可用于重建状态。

cards.definition: Data created from another system’s data (caches, indexes, views); can be rebuilt from the source.
cards.example: Search index derived from the database.

zh-Hans.definition: 由其他系统数据生成（缓存、索引、视图）、可从源数据重建的数据。

cards.definition: Lambda runs batch and stream paths side by side; Kappa uses one stream path and reprocesses by replay.
cards.example: Reprocess history by replaying Kafka.

zh-Hans.definition: Lambda 并行运行批处理与流处理；Kappa 只用流处理并通过重放再处理。

cards.definition: Grouping events by time: tumbling, hopping, sliding or session windows.
cards.example: Count errors per 1-minute tumbling window.

zh-Hans.definition: 按时间分组事件：滚动、跳跃、滑动或会话窗口。

cards.definition: Composing storage, indexes and caches as separate systems connected by event logs.
cards.example: Postgres → Kafka → Elasticsearch + Redis.

zh-Hans.definition: 将存储、索引和缓存作为独立系统，通过事件日志连接组合。

cards.definition: Each event affects the result as if processed once, via idempotence or atomic commit.
cards.example: Idempotent writes keyed by event ID.

zh-Hans.definition: 通过幂等或原子提交，使每个事件对结果的影响如同只处理一次。

cards.definition: Some correctness guarantees can only be enforced by the endpoints, e.g. unique request IDs.
cards.example: Dedupe by request ID despite retries.

zh-Hans.definition: 某些正确性保证只能由端点实现，如唯一请求 ID。

cards.definition: Packaged process with its dependencies and resource limits; the unit of the patterns.
cards.example: A Docker image deployed in a pod.

zh-Hans.definition: 打包了依赖和资源限制的进程；各模式的基本单元。

cards.definition: Latency: time per request; throughput: requests per second.
cards.example: p99 latency 120 ms at 5,000 req/s.

zh-Hans.definition: 延迟：每个请求耗时；吞吐量：每秒处理请求数。

cards.definition: Helper container running beside the app container, adding features like logging or TLS.
cards.example: An Envoy proxy next to every service.

zh-Hans.definition: 与应用容器并行运行、提供日志或 TLS 等功能的辅助容器。

cards.definition: Container that brokers the app’s outbound connections (sharding, discovery, retries).
cards.example: App talks to localhost; ambassador routes to the right shard.

zh-Hans.definition: 代理应用对外连接（分片、发现、重试）的容器。

cards.definition: Spreads requests across identical stateless replicas.
cards.example: Round-robin across 6 web servers.

zh-Hans.definition: 将请求分散到多个相同的无状态副本。

cards.definition: Check telling the orchestrator whether a replica can take traffic.
cards.example: /healthz returns 200 once caches are warm.

zh-Hans.definition: 告知编排器副本是否可以接收流量的检查。

cards.definition: Routing a client’s requests to the same replica.
cards.example: Sticky sessions keyed by client IP.

zh-Hans.definition: 将同一客户端的请求路由到同一副本。

cards.definition: Each replica serves only a subset of requests, chosen by a shard key, for stateful scale.
cards.example: Cache sharded by user ID.

zh-Hans.definition: 每个副本只处理由分片键决定的部分请求，用于有状态扩展。

cards.definition: Root sends a request to many leaves in parallel and merges their answers.
cards.example: Search across 10 index shards.

zh-Hans.definition: 根节点并行向多个叶节点发请求并合并结果。

cards.definition: The slowest leaf determines scatter/gather latency.
cards.example: One slow shard makes every search slow.

zh-Hans.definition: 最慢的叶节点决定分散/聚合的延迟。

cards.definition: Event-triggered functions run on demand without managing servers.
cards.example: A function resizes each uploaded image.

zh-Hans.definition: 按事件触发、按需运行的函数，无需管理服务器。

cards.definition: Choosing one owner for a task among replicas, usually via a lease in a consensus store.
cards.example: One replica holds the cron lock.

zh-Hans.definition: 在多个副本中为某任务选出唯一所有者，通常通过共识存储中的租约实现。

cards.definition: Time-limited ownership that must be renewed.
cards.example: A 30-second lock renewed every 10 s.

zh-Hans.definition: 有时限且需续约的所有权。

cards.definition: Queue of independent work items processed by a pool of workers.
cards.example: Thumbnail jobs pulled by 20 workers.

zh-Hans.definition: 由工作者池处理的独立工作项队列。

cards.definition: Chained work queues where the output of one stage triggers the next (copier, filter, splitter, sharder, merger).
cards.example: Upload → transcode → thumbnail → publish.

zh-Hans.term: 事件驱动批处理流水线
zh-Hans.definition: 前一阶段输出触发下一阶段的链式工作队列（复制、过滤、拆分、分片、合并）。

cards.definition: Coordinated batch step that waits for all parallel work to finish before continuing.
cards.example: Wait for every shard before reducing.

zh-Hans.definition: 等待所有并行工作完成后才继续的协调批处理步骤。

cards.definition: Understanding system behaviour from logs, metrics and traces.
cards.example: A trace shows which service added 300 ms.

zh-Hans.definition: 通过日志、指标和链路追踪理解系统行为。

cards.definition: Following one request across services with a shared trace ID.
cards.example: OpenTelemetry spans.

zh-Hans.definition: 用共享的追踪 ID 跟踪单个请求跨服务的路径。

cards.definition: Many clients retry or wake at once, overwhelming a service.
cards.example: Cache expiry triggers 10,000 identical DB queries.

zh-Hans.definition: 大量客户端同时重试或被唤醒，压垮服务。

cards.definition: Retry delays that grow exponentially with randomness to avoid synchronized retries.
cards.example: 100 ms, 200 ms, 400 ms… ± random.

zh-Hans.definition: 重试间隔按指数增长并加入随机性，避免同步重试。

cards.definition: Stops calling a failing dependency for a while so it can recover.
cards.example: After 5 failures, fail fast for 30 s.

zh-Hans.definition: 暂停调用故障依赖一段时间，使其得以恢复。
